cast_by: the ruling gate (2026-08-04-red-is-the-default-state) — CLAUDE.md's own rule that an IOU without a real ticket is itself the defect
intent: Make Law 9 physics: a component is RED unless something measured says otherwise. Today Law 9 is prose in CLAUDE.md, which is policy — the thing Law 4 says is a tracked debt, not a resting state.
why: Akien, 2026-08-04: 'everything not working is red should have been one of the very first rules of our development. so i am so ruling now' + 'a newly minted IDEA is red until it's in code and running.' As prose it binds only the reader who remembers it, at the moment they remember it — which is exactly how a component came to sit for weeks describing a design its code did not implement. The lived symptom: a person reads a charter, believes the component works as described, builds on it, and discovers otherwise later.
HELD_AT_THINKME_ON_PURPOSE: The mechanism is not obvious and building the obvious one would be worse than waiting. The naive version — a field on every component that says red or green — reproduces the defect exactly, because a hand-set field is another thing that can be wrong and nothing checks it. Green has to be DERIVED from something already measured (a green VALIDATION with a live seal, plus evidence the thing runs), and that means answering what 'and running' is measured against for a component that is a library rather than a device. Casting this at BUILDME would invite a boolean nobody can trust.
falsifier: DONE when a component whose code stops matching its charter, or whose proof goes red, or which has never run, READS as red without anyone marking it — measured by breaking one deliberately and observing the change. WRONG INTENT if the answer turns out to be a field somebody sets, or if 'and running' cannot be honestly measured for non-device components and the rule quietly narrows to devices without saying so.

TICKETME.need: what 'in code and running' measures to, per node class — a device has a process, a library does not. An answer that only works for devices is a narrower rule than the one that was ruled, and must say so out loud rather than pass as the whole thing.
the relationship to the VALIDATION seal already in the tester, which is the existing measured-green artifact and the obvious place to derive from rather than build beside (Law 1).

watchme: none, because it rests at THINKME; the watch question is answered when it is cast forward.
